edges.reason: phxProxy constructor invokes the inherited proxyOwner constructor.
proxyOwner constructor invokes the multiSignatureClient constructor.
Constructor persists the multiSignature address via saveValue.
Constructor sets the initial proxy owner to msg.sender.
Constructor sets the initial origin from tx.origin.
_setProxyOwner performs a raw sstore of the new owner.
_setProxyOwner performs a raw sstore of the expiry timestamp.
OwnershipTransferred event is emitted with the current owner().
Local expired receives now + ownerExpired before being stored.
_setProxyOrigin performs a raw sstore of the new origin.
Proxy constructor delegatecalls initialize() on the implementation.
Proxy constructor records the implementation and version.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership execution.
onlyOwner delegates the caller check to isOwner().
msg.sender is compared against the stored owner in isOwner().
Stored owner address is read for the ownership comparison.
isOwner requires the caller to be a contract via isContract().
isContract performs an inline assembly extcodesize check.
onlyOrigin gates transferOrigin execution.
msg.sender is compared with the stored origin in onlyOrigin.
The stored origin address is read for the access-control comparison.
OwnerOrOrigin gates upgradeTo execution.
tx.origin is used to initialise the stored origin during construction.
block.timestamp (now) determines the owner expiration window.
now + ownerExpired is computed without overflow protection under solc 0.5.16.
originOnce uses msg.sender compared against the stored origin.
originOnce reads the once-guard slot via getValue.
originOnce writes the once-guard slot via saveValue.
validCall modifier enforces checkMultiSignature before the guarded body.
checkMultiSignature reads callvalue via inline assembly.
msg.sender is hashed into the approved message hash.
checkMultiSignature resolves the multiSignature contract address.
checkMultiSignature reads the previously stored index via getValue.
checkMultiSignature persists the new approval index via saveValue.
External call to IMultiSignature.getValidSignature occurs before the state index is written, allowing reentrant re-entry into the approval flow.
getMultiSignatureAddress loads the slot via getValue.
getValue performs a raw sload.
saveValue performs a raw sstore.
transferOwnership delegates the storage update to _setProxyOwner.
transferOrigin delegates the storage update to _setProxyOrigin.
Fallback resolves the implementation address before forwarding.
Fallback delegatecalls arbitrary calldata to the implementation, which may re-enter the proxy.
upgradeTo reads the current implementation address.
upgradeTo records the new implementation through _setImplementation.
upgradeTo delegatecalls update() on the new implementation before validation.
_setImplementation delegatecalls implementationVersion() on the candidate implementation.
_setImplementation compares the new version with version().
_setImplementation updates the stored version.
_setImplementation performs a raw sstore of the implementation.
_setVersion performs a raw sstore of the version.
Constructor writes the multiSignature address to the dedicated slot.
getMultiSignatureAddress reads the multiSignature storage slot.
owner() loads the proxyOwnerPosition slot.
txOrigin() loads the proxyOriginPosition slot.
ownerExpiredTime() loads the ownerExpiredPosition slot.
version() loads the versionPositon slot.
implementation() loads the implementPositon slot.
originOnce derives its guard key from oncePosition.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter is only used for the address(0) check and slot write.
transferOwnership parameter is forwarded directly to _setProxyOwner.
_setProxyOwner parameter is consumed by the owner sstore and event.
transferOrigin parameter is forwarded directly to _setProxyOrigin.
_setProxyOrigin parameter is consumed by the origin sstore and event.
_setVersion parameter is consumed by the version sstore.
isContract parameter is only used for the extcodesize inspection.
Proxy constructor parameter flows into the delegatecall and _setImplementation.
_setImplementation parameter is stored and passed to the delegatecall.
upgradeTo parameter is passed to the delegatecall and _setImplementation.
saveValue slot parameter is the direct operand of the sstore.
saveValue value parameter is the direct operand of the sstore.
getValue slot parameter is the direct operand of the sload.
msgHash local is computed and used only inside checkMultiSignature.
value local is read via callvalue inside checkMultiSignature.
multiSign local is resolved and called inside checkMultiSignature.
index local is read and compared inside checkMultiSignature.
newIndex local is validated and stored inside checkMultiSignature.
key local is derived and used only within the originOnce modifier.
size local is the result of extcodesize inside isContract.
expired local is computed and stored only inside _setProxyOwner.
